Yes, we’re super excited to say that we do ship internationally! For customs and duties, it depends on where you’re ordering from:

If you’re in the UK or most of Europe, all import taxes and duties are included in the price—so there are no extra charges when your gorgeous jewellery arrives!
For the USA, a 30% tariff applies to purchases due to new regulations, and these charges are the customer’s responsibility.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges are set by your local carrier and laws, and you’ll need to cover those fees.
